beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Trustworthy AI follows a fictional assistant as useful answers acquire real consequences.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This engineering course asks what evidence justifies relying on each new capability.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its running system, Meridian, gains documents, tools, memory, and limited autonomy.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: You learn to connect specific failure paths to controls and release decisions.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Meridian may support internal policy research through approved repositories and read-only tools.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A factual answer must lead back to a retrievable source passage.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: If retrieval fails, the system should admit it cannot answer that policy question.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That fallback belongs to the promised behavior, alongside a human review route.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Now change the document repository while leaving the model itself unchanged.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Earlier test results may no longer support the same reliance claim.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book treats this as evidence decay, with affected claims requiring renewed checks.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Version-linked evidence makes those dependencies visible to the team deciding whether to release.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Meridian's behavior depends on data, the model, its surrounding software, and organizational decisions.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A missing source may become harmful when the interface hides uncertainty.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Useful review therefore needs evidence and authority to stop an unsupported release.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book connects these responsibilities with privacy, fairness, security, and human reliance.
